title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_siete_pazzi_a_mangiarlo_by_christophe_brusset_k7fzq (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_siete_pazzi_a_mangiarlo_by_christophe_brusset_k7fzq' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted machine. Simply removing the package does not guarantee removal of all malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
